subject.title: refactor(memory): split QMD manager by domain

question: Should maintainers accept this protected QMD refactor once required checks complete and a real after-fix QMD runtime transcript confirms the unchanged sync/search/status path?
rationale: The change is intentionally broad inside a stateful memory runtime, and the protected label requires a maintainer to weigh the maintenance benefit against the remaining behavioral-proof gap.

options.title: Require runtime proof before landing
options.body: Request a redacted live QMD sync/search/status transcript after the final rebase, then review the completed required checks.

options.title: Accept automated evidence only
options.body: Land based on the focused tests, changed-surface checks, build, and final green CI while accepting the absence of live runtime proof.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Defer this broad structural change if maintainers do not want to carry its review and regression surface in the current release window.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof before landing
recommendation.body: Request a redacted live QMD sync/search/status transcript after the final rebase, then review the completed required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available provenance ties steipete directly to the proposed QMD domain split and its validation narrative.
